objects.contents: coins x200, battle_axe crystal, scroll of fury x2, gold key

objects.name: Scout Perrin
objects.greeting: Keep low. They watch the road from the wall.|The gate takes a silver key. The marsh warden has one - she held this tower before they burnt the hill.
objects.topics: The warband=A score of them, and Thrakk. He is half again the size of the rest.; Beyond=Past the tower the road runs on to the Crystal Hollow. Nobody has come back down it since spring.

objects.title: The warlord's head
objects.offer: The Bortzal in the old watchtower answer to one they call Thrakk. Bring him down and the warband breaks. The town will pay, and so will I.
objects.remind: Thrakk keeps to the tower, behind the gate. It takes a silver key.
objects.thanks: Then the north road is open again. Take this - it was my mother's, and it has not been drawn in anger for years.
objects.reward: coins x300, sword crystal x1, greater health potion x2
